analysis.horizon_definition: N action steps / control fps, observation-relative; arrival time does not reset action deadlines
analysis.serialized_screen: With immediate one-flight prefetch and negligible local costs, adjacent prediction latencies must fit within H. Constant latency implies L<H/2. A p95 comparison is a screen, not a sustained-queue proof.
analysis.user_conservative_screen: 20% reserve on H/2 gives target p95<=0.4H. This is distinct from the existing evidence gate.
analysis.existing_gate: Existing qualification requires p95<=0.8*min(H-observation_age_p95,actual_merged_horizon_p05), plus sustained>=requested accepted warm requests,zero underruns and Stop proof. Ideal age=L with no local costs implies L<=4H/9. Real overhead/tick rounding makes this ceiling smaller.
analysis.scenario_note: Prior Molmo0.695181443s p95 applied to Smol/pi05 is hypothetical only; cannot substitute for per-model measurements or mapping qualification.
analysis.mapping_note: SmolVLA/pi05 remain blocked by unvalidated YAM dimensions/units/calibration/cameras irrespective of timing. Molmo source review is not physical validation.
